name: self-issued-ca-constraints-apply-to-leaf-invalid
description: Name constraints are not applied to a non-final self-issued certificate, but a self-issued CA's own nameConstraints extension still updates the path state for subsequent certificates. The self-issued rollover CA permits only example.com; the leaf below it is outside that subtree and must be rejected.
notes: This catches implementations that skip the entire name-constraints step for self-issued certificates, including processing the extension they carry, instead of skipping only the self-issued certificate's own subject/SAN name checks.
